task: Publish and read local text notifications with topics, tags and priorities
packaging_note: Replaced the store domain and generated server configuration with a local web page and a persistent message cache.
licence: Apache-2.0. The store template retains its licence in TEMPLATE-LICENSE.

access.why: The service uses a container network to serve its local address.

known_issues: Open a topic in the web page to subscribe. Messages can be read by other local software that knows the topic.
This local setup accepts text messages. File attachments require a configured public base URL and an attachment cache.
